en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad public square with a large Baroque-style plague column or fountain in the center and an ornate historic town hall building with a clock tower on the right. Several pedestrians stand in the open square. The front bottom margin carries handwritten-style captions that read "Pécs" on the left and "Városháza" on the right. The reverse side is a classic divided postcard back with address lines and stamp box, printed with publisher information in Hungarian.
